telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Choose what privacy-safe, aggregated usage data this proxy shares
telemetry.missingDestination: Telemetry is on but no destination is chosen, so nothing is recorded
telemetry.lastReport: Last report sent from this worker
telemetry.sampleReportHint: Made-up traffic through the real filter, with the groups that are on (all groups while telemetry is off)
telemetry.lastReportHint: Exactly what this worker last sent or stored
telemetry.howSent: How and when it is sent
telemetry.sendWindow: {{description}}. Changes apply from the next window
telemetry.privacy: Off by default. Each switch adds aggregated counts, never prompts, responses, keys, ids or header values. LITELLM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true turns everything off
telemetry.uiEventsHint: Sent only while Page navigation is on, to this proxy at POST /telemetry/ui_events, and counted into the same report as proxy traffic
telemetry.destinationHttp: One JSON report per worker every {{seconds}} s and on shutdown, by HTTP POST to LITELLM_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT. A failed send is retried next window
telemetry.destinationLocal: One report per worker every {{seconds}} s and on shutdown, stored in this proxy's LiteLLM_TelemetryReport table for {{days}} days. Nothing leaves the proxy. Admins can export from GET /telemetry/reports
telemetry.destinationNone: No destination is chosen, so nothing is recorded
telemetry.localTable: Local table (LiteLLM_TelemetryReport in this proxy's database)
telemetry.enterpriseContactDescription: Telemetry can't be turned on from this page. Reach out to your LiteLLM enterprise representative to turn it on for this proxy.
telemetry.enterpriseOnlyDescription: Telemetry is only available on LiteLLM Enterprise, and this proxy isn't on an enterprise license.
telemetry.envDisabledTitle: Telemetry is turned off by an environment variable
telemetry.envOverride: These override the settings on this page, which are read-only until they are removed.
telemetry.envStillEditable: The groups below can still be changed here.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat.counts: Random instance id, LiteLLM version, report window, which groups are on

requestSuccess.title: Request success
requestSuccess.slices: endpoint, LiteLLM status, provider status, stream, handled by Rust, LiteLLM cache hit
requestSuccess.counts: requests, provider attempts, latency to headers and to first byte
requestSuccess.helps: Error-rate and latency regressions, Rust vs Python

tokenInfo.title: Token info
tokenInfo.counts: input, output and cache-read token sums
tokenInfo.helps: Broken prompt caching or token counting

requestTaxonomy.title: Request taxonomy
requestTaxonomy.counts: one row per provider attempt with its status
requestTaxonomy.helps: Which provider is failing, retries and fallbacks

eventDetails.title: Event details
eventDetails.counts: message block counts and types, allowlisted header names (no values), provider time to first token
eventDetails.helps: Which request shapes and clients fail

instanceConfiguration.title: Instance configuration
instanceConfiguration.counts: names of allowlisted config keys that are set (no values)
instanceConfiguration.helps: Which features an upgrade must keep working

pageNavigation.title: Page navigation
pageNavigation.counts: Admin UI page views and tab switches by route name (no ids or typed text)
pageNavigation.helps: Which pages and tabs get used
